title: Deployment
description: Defines how user parameter values are transformed into Helm values via base values and patches.

base.description: Static Helm values applied unconditionally before any patches.

patches.description: Ordered list of conditional modifications applied to the base values.

path.description: Dot-notation path to the target value (e.g., 'ingress.hosts.0.host').

value.description: The value to set. Required for 'add' and 'replace' operations. Supports expression interpolation via {{ params.<id> }}.

when.description: Expression that must evaluate to true for the patch to apply. If omitted, the patch always applies.
